title: Reliability-aware anomaly detection of dairy cow lameness: analysis code
description: Analysis code implementing the methods described in the manuscript 'Reliability-aware anomaly detection of dairy cow lameness from side-view gait and energy images under commercial-farm crowding' (Scientific Reports): energy-image synthesis from binary silhouettes, four one-class anomaly detectors (PCA subspace, PatchCore, convolutional autoencoder, STFPM), cow-independent five-fold GroupKFold evaluation, label-permutation, severity, crowding and design-factor analyses, and a cross-check of the upstream YOLO11m-seg model. Energy images, silhouettes, videos and segmentation weights are available from the corresponding author and are not included.
